summary: Duplicate orders began at about 14:10 UTC, right after the redis-cache config change cut maxmemory from 4gb to 1gb with allkeys-lru eviction. Redis immediately hit maxmemory and evicted 6000-12000 keys per event. From 14:11:11, order-router logged 'idempotency key not found for retried webhook, treating as new order', so retried webhooks were executed again. The best-supported root cause is that the idempotency keys live in redis-cache and were evicted, though no log names the key store directly. The order-router deploy at 14:02 (dependency bump) is a weaker candidate: duplicates were 0.0 at 14:05, after that deploy. duplicate_orders plateaued at 18.0 and was still elevated at 14:35.

hypotheses.statement: The redis-cache maxmemory reduction (4gb to 1gb) caused LRU eviction of idempotency keys. order-router then treated retried webhooks as new orders and executed duplicates.
hypotheses.label: high

supporting.text: redis-cache maxmemory was cut from 4gb to 1gb at 14:10, with LRU eviction
Redis began mass eviction right after the change
order-router started treating retried webhooks as new orders at 14:11:11 and kept doing so
duplicate_orders was 0 before 14:10 and rose from then
redis-cache memory reached 97% with 12000 keys evicted

hypotheses.statement: The order-router 00601 dependency bump broke idempotency handling.
hypotheses.label: low

facts.text: redis-cache maxmemory was cut from 4gb to 1gb at 14:10, with LRU eviction
Redis began mass eviction right after the change
order-router started treating retried webhooks as new orders at 14:11:11 and kept doing so
duplicate_orders was 0 before 14:10 and rose from then
redis-cache memory reached 97% with 12000 keys evicted

unresolved: No log or dependency data shows that idempotency keys live in redis-cache.
The order-router-00601 deploy has not been ruled out as a contributing factor.
Why webhooks were retried at all is not established. inbound-msgs redeliveries looked steady, but only summary stats were checked.
Exact count and customer impact of duplicate orders is unknown. The log queries were truncated.

actions.text: Roll back redis-cache maxmemory to 4gb, or at least size it above the working set, and confirm evictions stop.
actions.rationale: The config change at 14:10 matches the onset of evictions and duplicate orders.

actions.text: Identify and reconcile the duplicate orders executed since 14:10 (about 18 per the metric). Reverse them or notify affected customers.
actions.rationale: Duplicate executions are customer-impacting and duplicate_orders was still 18.0 at 14:35.

actions.text: Move idempotency keys to durable storage (postgres, or a Redis keyspace with no eviction and a TTL). Fail closed when a key is missing instead of treating the webhook as a new order.
actions.rationale: Order safety should not depend on an evictable cache.

actions.text: Verify where order-router stores idempotency keys. Check whether deploy order-router-00601 changed the idempotency code.
actions.rationale: This confirms H1 and rules out H2, which the current evidence cannot separate.
